question: What is the name of the Project?

question: Is Metro Line 4 operational? What is the status of Surya Nagar Metro Station?

Currently operational rail transit includes Vikhroli Railway Station on the Central Line (0.4 KM / 2-minute walk) and Ghatkopar Metro Station on Line 1 (4.1 KM / 8 minutes).

The building structure comprises:
